title: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 Iloilo Review: A Nighttime Race in the City of Love
seo_title: HOKA Midnight Run Asia Iloilo 2026 Review | RunRio
meta_description: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 Iloilo review: October 25 -- a premium shoe brand's nighttime race format comes to historic Iloilo City.
dek: Set for 25 October 2026, this Iloilo leg brings HOKA's Midnight Run Asia nighttime race format to one of the Philippines' oldest cities, previously the country's second most important after Manila.
verdict: HOKA Midnight Run Asia's Iloilo leg pairs a premium performance-shoe brand with one of the Philippines' most historically significant cities -- Iloilo was granted the honorific 'La Muy Leal y Noble Ciudad' in 1889 and had become the country's second most important city after Manila by the late 19th century. The 'Midnight Run' nighttime format, seen also at the Cebu leg covered elsewhere in this research, is a genuine departure from the pre-dawn starts typical of most Philippine road races. Three distances (21K/10K/5K) keep it standard, though registration status wasn't yet announced at the time of this research.

sections.heading: Iloilo City: Once the Philippines' Second City
paragraphs: Iloilo City is the regional centre of Western Visayas and one of the oldest cities in the Philippines, granted city status by royal decree in 1889 with the honorific title 'La Muy Leal y Noble Ciudad.' [2] By the late 19th century, it had become the second most important city in the Philippines after Manila -- a level of historical significance that gives race weekend genuine cultural depth.
